files.label: Files
files.description: Files in the folders you can view (one row per file, with the current version).

hints.extension: lower case, without the dot: pdf, ifc, dwg
hints.folderPath: without the root folder, separated by ' / '

files.dynamicDescription: File attributes, e.g. attributes.Status, attributes.Revision, attributes.Discipline

versions.label: Versions
versions.description: All versions of the files you can view (one row per upload). Use it for upload activity.

issues.label: Issues
issues.description: Issues in the project (one row per issue).

hints.assigneeCompany: the assigned company or the assignee's company
hints.overdue: due date before today and the issue is not closed
hints.daysOverdue: days past the due date; otherwise null

activity.label: Activity Log
activity.description: The project's audit log: uploads, downloads, issue and permission changes. Project administrators only.

hints.action: e.g. file.uploaded, file.version_added, file.downloaded, file.deleted, issue.created, issue.updated, issue.commented, folder.permissions_set, member.added, report.saved

models.label: Models (IFC)
models.description: IFC versions you can view; one row per IFC class (ifcClass, classCount). Use sum(classCount) for the class breakdown; elementCount repeats on every row.

hints.isOpen: true unless the status is closed
hints.ballInCourt: the company (or companies) whose turn it is; empty for closed work items
hints.daysOverdue: days past the due date; otherwise null
hints.daysOpen: days from sending to the reply / closing, or to today
hints.awaitingReply: reply required and the status is sent/received
hints.status: status code; statusLabel holds its name

works.label: Work (all)
works.description: All work items you can see: correspondence, RFIs, submittals, meetings, actions, transmittals. One row per work item.

correspondence.label: Correspondence
correspondence.description: Incoming and outgoing letters (one row per letter): awaiting reply, due date, company, delivery channel, language.

hints.counterparty: the sender of an incoming letter, the recipient company of an outgoing one

rfis.label: RFIs
rfis.description: RFIs (one row per RFI): ball in court, days open, discipline, category, impact, answer.

submittals.label: Submittals
submittals.description: Submittal items (one row per item): revision, last outcome, specification section, type, discipline, package, ball in court, delay.

hints.reviewDays: last revision: from submission to decision, or to today
hints.outcome: code of the last decision; null without a decision

meetings.label: Meetings
meetings.description: Meetings (one row per meeting): type, date, participants, numbers of minutes items and actions.

hints.kind: e.g. Coordination, Progress, Health and Safety

actions.label: Actions
actions.description: Meeting actions (one row per action): responsible person and company, due date, delay, meeting.

transmittals.label: Transmittals
transmittals.description: Transmittals (one row per transmittal): purpose, recipient, sent and received dates, number of attached files.

hints.received: at least one recipient company acknowledged receipt

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.description: Document reviews (one row per review): status, current step, step due date, delay, file outcomes, total time, target folder gate.

hints.currentStep: name of the step while running
hints.overdue: running and the step due date has passed
hints.totalDays: from start to finish, or to today
hints.gated: files enter the target folder only through an approved review

reviewFiles.label: Review Files
reviewFiles.description: Files in reviews (one row per review × file): last outcome and decision date per file.

hints.stoppedAtStep: if the chain stopped at this step (starts at 1)
hints.outcome: the file's last outcome; null without a decision

workflowSteps.label: Workflow Steps
workflowSteps.description: Steps in the approval workflows of reviews, RFIs, submittals and forms (one row per step pass): responsible, responsible company, start, finish, duration (days), overdue. Use the sum/average of days for 'who kept it waiting how long'.

hints.subject: review name / work item number / form number
hints.responsible: person, company or team assigned to the step (comma-separated)
hints.days: to the finish or to today, with decimals
hints.late: past its due date (finished or running step)

locations.label: Locations
locations.description: Location tree (block, level, room, chainage; one row per location) with the numbers of forms and issues linked to it.

hints.failedItemCount: total of the forms at this location

docComparisons.label: Document Comparisons
docComparisons.description: Comparisons between two versions (one row per comparison): numbers of changed pages and lines, title block changes, revision warnings.

hints.contentChanged: text change outside the title block
hints.antetChanges: number of changed title block fields
hints.warningCount: e.g. revision not updated, revision table not updated

specRegisters.label: Specification Submittal Registers
specRegisters.description: Submittal items extracted from specifications (one row per item): source file, section, type, discipline, page.

hints.description: short description, e.g. 'Data sheet / catalogue – Air handling unit'

issueStatus.name: Issue Status (company and priority)
issueStatus.description: Open/closed issue counts, open issues by company and priority breakdown.

text.title: Title
text.last12Weeks: Last 12 weeks, weekly (weeks start on Monday)
text.subject: Subject
text.openRfisByBallInCourt: Open RFIs by Ball in Court
text.noOpenFormsWithFailedItems: No open forms with failed items.
text.sCurveComment: S-curve: cumulative percentage of monthly finishes.
text.blankComment: d.<query id> holds the rows. Charts: CDE.bar / CDE.line / CDE.pie / CDE.kpi / CDE.table
text.addQueryHint: Add a query in the Advanced section.

overdue.name: Overdue Items
overdue.description: Overdue open issues, their breakdown by company and due dates in the next 7 days.

uploadActivity.name: Document Upload Activity (weekly)
uploadActivity.description: Weekly uploads over the last 12 weeks, breakdown by company and top uploaders.

modelElements.name: Model Element Breakdown
modelElements.description: Element counts by IFC class in the current IFC versions and totals per model.

correspondenceStatus.name: Correspondence Status
correspondenceStatus.description: Open letters, letters awaiting reply, overdue letters, breakdown by company and monthly incoming/outgoing letters.

rfiLog.name: RFIs
rfiLog.description: Open RFIs, breakdown by ball in court and discipline, days open and average response time.

submittalRegister.name: Submittal Register
submittalRegister.description: Outcome breakdown of submittal items, revision counts, status by type and overdue items.

meetingsActions.name: Meetings and Actions
meetingsActions.description: Open actions, breakdown by responsible company, overdue actions and recent meetings.

reviewsSteps.name: Reviews (step durations)
reviewsSteps.description: Running reviews, overdue steps, average time per step and waiting time by company.

formsFailures.name: Forms (failed items)
formsFailures.description: Form counts, failed items by location and template, forms per week and open forms with failed items.

scheduleProgress.name: Schedule (delays, critical path, S-curve)
scheduleProgress.description: Activity statuses, late critical activities, delays by WBS and the S-curve of planned / forecast / actual finishes.

cost5d.name: Cost (5D)
cost5d.description: Cost of model elements at unit rates: totals by category and storey, largest items, missing quantities and planned / actual cash flow (S-curve).

clashOverview.name: Clashes
clashOverview.description: Open clashes, IFC class pairs, assigned companies and status breakdown by test.

docCompare.name: Document Comparisons
docCompare.description: Version comparisons: changed pages, title block changes and revision warnings.

worksOverview.name: Open Work (ball in court)
worksOverview.description: Open work items by category, breakdown by ball in court and overdue work items.
